newsitem.title: FINLAND: METRA SAYS TO INVEST FIM 175 MLN.
newsitem.headline: METRA SAYS TO INVEST FIM 175 MLN.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Metra Oy Ab said on Friday its Sanitec Oy Ltd bathroom porcelain unit would invest 175 million markka in a Middle East joint venture with members of the Lebanese Gargour family.
"Sanitec's equity investment will be 175 million markka in the joint venture," Metra said in a statement.
Sanitec and its Lebanese partners will acquire control of Lecico, "a leading manufacturer of sanitaryware and ceramic tiles in the Middle East," Metra said.
"Lecico goup's total net sales are $81 million and the number of employees 3,080," it said.
Sanitec and members of the Gargour family will set up a 50-50 owned joint venture that will be registered in the Netherlands, it said.
The new company would obtain 75 percent of Lecico Egypt s.a.e. and 93 percent of Lecico Lebanon s.a.l., Metra said.

"Through this joint venture Sanitec will gain a share in two profitable companies and a leading market position in Egypt and Lebanon ... and the opportunity to enter the markets in the Middle East, the U.K. and Africa," Metra said.

Sanitec's partners will be Toufick, Gilbert and Alain Gargour as representatives of one of the founding families of Gargour Holdings S.A., a diversified company operating in trade and industry throughout the Middle East, it said.
"Lecico Lebanon is the market leader in Lebanon with sales of sanitaryware and tiles of $20 million (approximately 100 million markka) in 1996," it said.
"Lecico Egypt is the market leader in Egypt and had net sales of $61 million (approximately 300 million markka) and 2,400 employees in 1996," Metra said.
Lecico Egypt exports to Europe, especially to the U.K. and France, it said.
Sanitec Oy Ltd, with net sales of 2.7 billion markka in 1996, is "the largest producer of bathroom ceramics and a major supplier of other bathroom products in Europe," Metra said.
